capability: Learn full-battle choices without forgetting demonstrated earlier battle competence.
learned_authority: Three existing learned heads continue to select moves, reserves and attack/switch; no rules or teacher substitution gain authority.
transfer_test: Only after unchanged TRAIN retention and terminal-improvement gates pass, qualify the frozen candidate on unused natural trainer sources, then bounded player integration. Never reuse consumed DEVELOPMENT sources.
cheapest_falsifier: ROM-free reconstruction of 180 authenticated TRAIN targets, conflicting-input and reward-scale analysis, and feasible retained model inspection.
time_box: One session, at most two hours; one prospective constrained fit after the audit, no hyperparameter sweep.
stop_condition: Stop the candidate on retention or terminal-improvement failure; stop promotion if natural transfer cannot be demonstrated. Preserve every failure and do not loosen thresholds.
audit_result: 180 contexts authenticated. No identical-input conflicting preference crosses old/new groups. The 100-context ancestor satisfies all unchanged retention limits; this proves a feasible start, not successful terminal learnability.

fit.start: Frozen 100-context terminal ancestor; algebraic zero-new-weight control schema bridge preserves old scores
fit.objective: Expected regret on 128 full-battle contexts, with hard preservation of every old52 head decision
fit.acceptance: Actual nonlinear loss decreases and every older head argmax and protected margin are preserved; otherwise stop that head
fit.terminal_gate: At least 10% improvement in terminal128 composed regret and no increase in new80 composed regret; old gates unchanged
